lines.text: Would you rather pay 926 a month, or just 453?

parts.tts: Would you rather pay nine hundred twenty-six a month, or just four hundred fifty-three?
parts.heard: Would you rather pay $926 a month or just $453?

lines.text: Same 30,000 dollar car. Same seven percent. Pick one...

parts.tts: Same thirty thousand dollar car. Same seven percent. Pick one...

lines.text: Spender picked 453. Half the payment! Easy choice, right?

parts.tts: Spender picked four hundred fifty-three. Half the payment! Easy choice, right?
parts.heard: Spender picked 453. Half the payment. Easy choice, right?

lines.text: But 453 means seven years, not three. And behind that door, something is eating his money...

parts.tts: But four hundred fifty-three means seven years, not three. And behind that door, something is eating his money...
parts.heard: But 453 means seven years, not three. And behind that door, something is eating his money.

lines.text: Seven years costs 8,034 in interest. Three years: 3,347.

parts.tts: Seven years costs eight thousand thirty-four in interest. Three years: three thousand three hundred forty-seven.
parts.heard: Seven years costs 8,034 in interest. Three years, 3,347.

lines.text: The cheap payment burns about 4,700 extra.

parts.tts: The cheap payment burns about four thousand seven hundred extra.
parts.heard: The cheap payment burns about $4,700 extra.
